$comment: Automation Worker delivery config: what is deployed where, and which verification gates each kind of change runs. Read by tests/run.mjs, deploy/deploy.mjs and deploy/verify_live.mjs. No secrets: the hosting account and API token come from the environment (HOSTINGER_USERNAME, HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN).

build.$comment: env holds public build values only (the Brevo form URL is the live page's form action). The environment overrides them.

change_types.why: palette, type, motif, layout or chat styling
pages, components, the assistant, its tools or its runtime
the Brevo binding and n8n workflows (needs a FRACTEDGE-platform checkout: skipped on PRs, run nightly)
the pipeline, its tests or the deploy itself

gates.hygiene: no secret, token, hosting account id or personal email in any tracked file (public repo)
gates.dist: the committed dist/ is exactly what the source builds: what is reviewed is what is deployed
gates.contract: the assistant's network, manifest and tools, through the real runtime with a scripted model
gates.pipeline: the change-type routing and the workflow's trigger, go-live guard, rollback and drill
gates.content: every post is valid, unique, built, listed for the assistant and readable by it; internal links resolve
gates.brand: CSS tokens match the brand file; the three fonts load; text and UI colours pass contrast
gates.rendered: the built site in headless Chromium at each viewport: the assistant boots, no sideways scroll, a real read; screenshots
gates.chat: a full chat turn against the mock provider in ok, error and empty modes: an answer, a visible error, a notice; never a blank
gates.newsletter: the n8n workflow files answer their fixtures on the Brevo twin
gates.live: after deploy: MIME and cache headers, the live files equal dist/, and the rendered check against the live site
